'''0.20e''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that adjusted some item stats and fixed various bugs.

==Changelog==
* Modified markers above the players
* Reduced weight of the Renaissance Army armored vest
* [[AKM]] recoil tweaked
* [[SKS]] recoil tweaked
* [[Kiparis]] SMG reload time increased

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed a bug with falling through geometry on the [[Fort]] location
* Fixed a critical bug when changing screen resolution
* Fixed a critical bug when loading locations for users with 'bad' internet
* Fixed a critical bug when leaving a match
* Fixed a bug with displaying squads in the list of players
* Fixed a bug with the message displayed on unlocking a faction level
* Fixed a bug when choosing the player with the best accuracy
* Fixed a bug when accomplishing the shooting accuracy task
* Fixed a bug with drawing grass on the [[Radar]] location
